Faysal Hoca is definitely very competent in his field and a student-friendly instructor. He tries to help students with all kinds of problems and genuinely cares about them. I would say the course is generally engaging and interactive. However, I think it would be more appropriate if exam questions focused more on assessing knowledge. Even though the course requires a certain level of creativity, I do not think every student can meet this expectation regardless of how much they study. Answering questions with clear, definite answers may feel more reassuring and fair to students. Additionally, sharing clear criteria for tasks such as Pecha-Kucha presentations and assignments could help students better understand expectations.
